messages.subject: Kanu | MENA Financial Services Executive | Regulatory Affairs, ESG and Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Kanu,

Your leadership of banking and financial-services executive search across MENA makes this a focused introduction. My background combines five years in regulated banking with current Director-level responsibility for government relations, ESG, external affairs and institutional stakeholder leadership within a multinational mining group.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory engagement, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, compliance coordination, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications. Earlier, I spent five years with Scotiabank in Guyana.

This combination gives me a cross-sector profile suited to senior roles where business strategy depends on regulatory judgement, institutional trust, responsible growth and country-facing execution.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Strategic Partnerships, Regulatory Strategy and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am open to wider GCC regional assignments.

I have attached a MENA financial-services-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
